summary: Server singleton of the drop-in (join game) approval flow: the approval requests that arrived this frame, as eoc::multiplayer::DropInRequestInfo (user, request Guid, player name). Cleared and refilled by esv::multiplayer::DropInApprovalSystem::ProcessApprovalRequests. Seen.py context: idle level (singleton exists from world creation; never seen non-empty - single-player test stand).

fields.name: UserID
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x2D8760 ProcessApprovalRequests builds the element on the stack: +0 = dword +0x3C of the incoming esv::multiplayer::PlayerConnectInfo (the user id; default Unassigned). Windows bg3.exe+0x2F38A90 builds the same element: +0 = PlayerConnectInfo+0x3C, +8 = two 8-byte halves of a generated Guid, +0x18 = STDString copy of PlayerConnectInfo+0x20 (size +0x28, capacity +0x2C = 0xF); clearing walks the elements with stride 0x30 and frees the string.
